notes.title: Patch 0.001
notes.notes:
At the request of our players, we have made some changes to the game.

[list]
[*] Removed camera shake.
[*] Added the ability to change the difficulty level of the game. You can change it in the game settings.
[*] The character can now not only walk but also run.
[*] The maximum brightness threshold has been increased. You can change the brightness in the game settings.
[*] The level with the maze has been updated, but we are still working on it and it will be updated.
[/list]

notes.title: Quest Room released
notes.notes:
The long-awaited day has arrived.
Quest Room has been released today.
Congratulations to all players for the opportunity to become part of the story of the protagonist.

We tried for you and we think that you will enjoy the game.
Our team is waiting for your adequate feedback, so that we can develop and our new games will be even better.

A big thank you to everyone who has taken part in developing the game.
Have a nice day and a great mood.

notes.title: Acknowledgements.
notes.notes:
It's happening! We have finally finished development of the Quest room.
Many thanks to everyone who took part in the testing of the game. Not only did we get the stability and performance of the game, but we also found out a lot of other useful information. We have carefully studied the feedback we received from you. You have been a great help to the developers and we are looking forward to working with such a great community again.
